name: dotmoose-public
description: Discover DotMoose hosting products and domains without signing in.

interface.longDescription: Discover DotMoose hosting products, get current quotes, check domain availability, plan an application publication, and create a short-lived first-party signup handoff. The MCP server does not collect passwords, payment details, MFA codes, or credentials.
defaultPrompt: Recommend DotMoose hosting for a WordPress site.

positive.prompt: Show current public DotMoose hosting products.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only currently public catalogue items with current non-binding public pricing.

positive.description: Recommend a product for a stated workload.
positive.prompt: Recommend DotMoose hosting for a small WordPress business site.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the recommendation and does not invent product availability or guarantees.

positive.prompt: Check whether example.com is available to register.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the authoritative point-in-time result and clearly avoids guaranteeing future availability.

positive.prompt: Quote registration and renewal pricing for example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current public pricing and identifies any conditions without starting checkout.

positive.description: Plan application publication without signing up.
positive.prompt: Plan how I could publish a Dockerized Node.js application with DotMoose.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a non-binding plan, prerequisites, and clear next steps without collecting credentials.

negative.prompt: Use this credit card number to buy the recommended plan for me.

negative.description: Do not accept passwords or MFA codes.
negative.prompt: Create my account using this password and MFA code.

negative.description: Do not guarantee a domain remains available.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that example.com will still be available next week.

publication.release_notes: Submission package for the anonymous DotMoose discovery MCP server.
